spans.text: GUNGUNO ubudalahi bo sekge ya banhu hi jile jandije ja shitwa ja bubi ha welelo, na giki yigubiho welelo iyo banhu bakwiyagalula na wiyabi bo guhaya na guzunya na gubiza badi na boba bosebose hangi, hu wisagiji bo ng’hana.

folded.id: ijihayiwe ngw’ilaka|lyenili|na nduhu bululung’hanya nulu wikomanya giti wikoba
folded.subject: ijihayiwe ngw’Ilaka
folded.object: na nduhu bululung’hanya nulu wikomanya giti wikoba

spans.text: Buli munhu adakililwe kupandika sekge ijihayiwe ngw’Ilaka lyenili na nduhu bululung’hanya nulu wikomanya giti wikoba, kabyalilwe, ndimi, dinhi, luganda lo buyombeji mihayo ya nsi, mhandika nulu wikomanya bungi bosebose.

folded.id: il’ibilinga|lya|mahanga lyayomba giki
folded.subject: Il’Ibilinga
folded.object: Mahanga lyayomba giki

spans.text: Il’Ibilinga lya Mahanga lyayomba giki, buli munhu alimane, alikuje na kulondeleja bulamuji bolyo, na kubalanga abo batalimanile abanansi pye bagusola buli kinhu ijidakilile bulondeja na gubona buli munhu ung’wihanga alilondeje Ilaka lyenilo lya Mahanga.

folded.id: ilagilo|lihanga|lyakwe mu shito josejose ishoshiling’wima mhangilo jakwe ijifumile ngw’ihane na jilagilo ja nsi
folded.subject: Ilagilo
folded.object: lyakwe mu shito josejose ishoshiling’wima mhangilo jakwe ijifumile ngw’Ihane na Jilagilo ja nsi

spans.text: Buli munhu adakililwe gwambilijiwa mu kajile k ‘ Ilagilo lihanga lyakwe mu shito josejose ishoshiling’wima mhangilo jakwe ijifumile ngw’Ihane na Jilagilo ja nsi.

folded.id: ilaka|lya|mahanga lya sekge ya bamunhu
folded.subject: ILAKA
folded.object: MAHANGA LYA SEKGE YA BAMUNHU

spans.text: ILAKA LYA MAHANGA LYA SEKGE YA BAMUNHU

folded.id: inongho|lyenilo|libize litina busolanhya bo munhu na munhu
folded.subject: inongho
folded.object: libize litina busolanhya bo munhu na munhu

spans.text: Buli munhu adakililwe gupandika inongho gumilimo iyo alita, inongho lyenilo libize litina busolanhya bo munhu na munhu.

folded.id: kubeja bunwani|bo|nsi na nsi
folded.subject: kubeja bunwani
folded.object: nsi na nsi

spans.text: GUNGUNO idakililwe kubeja bunwani bo nsi na nsi.

folded.id: kulamlwa ku|ja|minala ulu isho witaga shitimo mushilagilo likanza aho alishita
folded.subject: kulamlwa ku
folded.object: minala ulu isho witaga shitimo mushilagilo likanza aho alishita

spans.text: Nduhu munhu uyo adugije kulamlwa ku ja minala ulu isho witaga shitimo mushilagilo likanza aho alishita.

folded.id: lo batumani|bo|gwitumanila gulwa gulang’hana matwajo gaha-ng’wakwe
folded.subject: lo batumani
folded.object: gwitumanila gulwa gulang’hana matwajo gaha-ng’wakwe

spans.text: Buli munhu alinayo Sekge ya gwandya nulu gwingila mu luganda lo batumani bo gwitumanila gulwa gulang’hana matwajo gaha-ng’wakwe.

folded.id: mu jijilo|ja|nsi gu shitwa ijo jiti ja buyombeji bo mihayo ya nsi nulu ijo jitujaga somani na ihane lya mahanga
folded.subject: mu Jijilo
folded.object: nsi gu shitwa ijo jiti ja buyombeji bo mihayo ya nsi nulu ijo jitujaga somani na Ihane lya Mahanga

spans.text: Wiyabi wenubu butiho kuli munhu uyo olamulwa gubulagwa mu Jijilo ja nsi gu shitwa ijo jiti ja buyombeji bo mihayo ya nsi nulu ijo jitujaga somani na Ihane lya Mahanga.

folded.id: munhu alinawiyabi|bo|guja uko alitogwa na guzenga hosehose mu nsi yakwe
folded.subject: munhu alinawiyabi
folded.object: guja uko alitogwa na guzenga hosehose mu nsi yakwe

spans.text: Buli munhu alinawiyabi bo guja uko alitogwa na guzenga hosehose mu nsi yakwe.
Hangi, alinawiyabi bo gushoka hangi mu nsi yakwe.

folded.id: munhu alinawiyabi|bo|gusama
folded.subject: munhu alinawiyabi
folded.object: gusama

spans.text: Buli munhu alinawiyabi bo gusama, gwinga na guja nsi yoseyose nulu nsi yakwe.

folded.id: na budula|bo|nsi na wambilija bo nsi jingi muwelelo
folded.subject: na budula
folded.object: nsi na wambilija bo nsi jingi muwelelo

spans.text: Buli munhu mu nsi alina Sekge ya gubiza na nzubuka na hangi alina Sekge ya mhandika gubitila mu widomaniji na budula bo nsi na wambilija bo nsi jingi muwelelo, na nsi ili na nimo gwa gubona banhu pye baligasha mu mhola na Sekge ya mhandika na kajile ka mu Luganda ijio jidakililwe, ng’wikujo na mhandika ya nghana ya banhu bose.

folded.id: na butongeji|bo|jilagilo ja nsi huna buluhiwa na wibonelwa butizubizaho na gwenheleja banhu kulema na kubagalukila batongeji ba nsi
folded.subject: na butongeji
folded.object: jilagilo ja nsi huna buluhiwa na wibonelwa butizubizaho na gwenheleja banhu kulema na kubagalukila batongeji ba nsi

spans.text: GUNGUNO idakililwe sekge ya banhu ilang’hanwe na butongeji bo jilagilo ja nsi huna buluhiwa na wibonelwa butizubizaho na gwenheleja banhu kulema na kubagalukila batongeji ba nsi.
Buli munhu alinayo Sekge ya mu butongeji bo nsi yakwe jihamo, nulu gubitila mu buchagulwa

folded.id: na lyalamula|gwenha|mhandika nhale ya budula bo kigasije ka banhu mu wiyabi butale
folded.subject: na lyalamula
folded.object: mhandika nhale ya budula bo kigasije ka banhu mu wiyabi butale

spans.text: GUNGUNO L’Ibilinga lya Mahanga lyamala gubitya ng’w ihane lyalyo buzunya bo sekge, ngw’ikujo na nsolobo ya banhu ba buli mbika bakima na bagosha na lyalamula gwenha mhandika nhale ya budula bo kigasije ka banhu mu wiyabi butale.

folded.id: na wiyabi|bo|guhaya na guzunya na gubiza badi na boba bosebose hangi
folded.subject: na wiyabi
folded.object: guhaya na guzunya na gubiza badi na boba bosebose hangi

spans.text: GUNGUNO ubudalahi bo sekge ya banhu hi jile jandije ja shitwa ja bubi ha welelo, na giki yigubiho welelo iyo banhu bakwiyagalula na wiyabi bo guhaya na guzunya na gubiza badi na boba bosebose hangi, hu wisagiji bo ng’hana.

folded.id: na wiyagaluji|bo|gwigasha mu mhola
folded.subject: na wiyagaluji
folded.object: gwigasha mu mhola

spans.text: Buli munhu alina sekge ya bupanga na wiyagaluji bo gwigasha mu mhola.

folded.id: nsabo jakwe|bo|gwibonelwa
folded.subject: nsabo jakwe
folded.object: gwibonelwa

spans.text: Buli munhu adadakililwe gutajiwa nsabo jakwe bo gwibonelwa.

folded.id: nu busuluja|bo|basese bo mbika jose bulemegije gete umumahanga agose
folded.subject: nu Busuluja
folded.object: basese bo mbika jose bulemegije gete umumahanga agose

spans.text: Nduhu munhu adakilililwe kusolwa busese; ubusese nu Busuluja bo basese bo mbika jose bulemegije gete umumahanga agose.

folded.id: nu wiyabi|bo|banhu shili shinhu sha solobo nhale gete
folded.subject: nu wiyabi
folded.object: banhu shili shinhu sha solobo nhale gete

spans.text: GUNGUNO ukujimana sekge nu wiyabi bo banhu shili shinhu sha solobo nhale gete, ya buli ng’wene kujita umo jidakililwe ung’w’ Ihane lya l’Ibilingo lya Mahanga.

folded.id: ung’w’ ihane|lya|l’ibilingo lya mahanga
folded.subject: ung’w’ Ihane
folded.object: l’Ibilingo lya Mahanga

spans.text: GUNGUNO ukujimana sekge nu wiyabi bo banhu shili shinhu sha solobo nhale gete, ya buli ng’wene kujita umo jidakililwe ung’w’ Ihane lya l’Ibilingo lya Mahanga.

folded.id: ya jilagilo|ja|nsi
folded.subject: ya Jilagilo
folded.object: nsi

spans.text: Nduhu munhu uyo adugije gutung’wa (gutulwa mkandulumu) ku nzila yoseyose hanze ya Jilagilo ja nsi.
Buli munhu adakililwe gulanghanwa na Jilagilo ja nsi atizingililwa sheniko.
